The cheapest plan under the stated costs defers everyone and drives nothing. Nilkantha market is unreachable because both of its roads are blocked. Rescuing the toddler at Belkot would cost 186 driving minutes (20 + 51 + 22 + 22 + 51 + 20), which is more than the 60-minute deferral penalty for a child.

<plan>
defer belkot-village child 1
defer nilkantha-market adult 3
</plan>

COST: 120

Before acting on this, the coordinators should check it. The objective counts a deferred child as only 60 minutes, but in practice a toddler waiting for help should almost certainly be rescued even though the drive is expensive. If you want the toddler rescued, the plan is:

drive car1 bidur-shelter suryagadhi-farm (20)
drive car1 suryagadhi-farm likhu-care-home (51)
drive car1 likhu-care-home belkot-village (22)
load car1 child 1
drive car1 belkot-village likhu-care-home (22)
drive car1 likhu-care-home suryagadhi-farm (51)
drive car1 suryagadhi-farm bidur-shelter (20)
unload car1 child 1

That plan costs 186 + 120 = 306. The three adults at Nilkantha market stay deferred either way, since no road reaches them.
